summary: Examples of sysvinit: start and enable apache2, restart with a 5-second sleep, and enable on runlevels 3 and 5.
questions: How do I enable apache2 on runlevels 3 and 5?
How do I add a delay between stop and start?

answer_card.title: sysvinit examples
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
- ansible.builtin.sysvinit: {name: apache2, state: started, enabled: yes}
- ansible.builtin.sysvinit: {name: apache2, state: restarted, sleep: 5}
- ansible.builtin.sysvinit:
    name: apache2
    state: started
    enabled: yes
    runlevels: [3, 5]
```
